subject: DI04000251

h.en: 6.1.1 Pressure vessel:pressure is not a whole design
h.gu: 6.1.1 Pressure Vessel:ફક્ત Pressureથી Design પૂરું નહિ

body.en:
Start with the situation

An air receiver, a steam drum and a hydraulic cylinder all contain pressure, but their temperature, corrosion, cycles and geometry differ.

Definition / principle

A pressure vessel contains fluid under a pressure difference and must resist the resulting membrane/local stresses under applicable rules.

Understand why

Use gauge differential pressure for the stated stress case; internal and external pressures need consistent treatment.

Application / illustration

Thin/thick is primarily a wall-to-radius modelling distinction, not simply a low/high-pressure name.

Common mistake / conditions

These calculations teach elementary stress design, not code compliance, inspection approval or authority to build/test a pressure vessel.

Is longitudinal membrane stress valid for every open tube?

No. The closed-end pressure-load assumption must hold.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Air receiver,steam drum,hydraulic cylinderમાં pressure છે,પણ temperature,corrosion,cycles,geometry જુદાં છે.

Definition / Principle

Pressure vessel pressure differenceવાળું fluid રાખે,applicable rules મુજબ membrane/local stresses resist કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated stress caseમાં differential gauge pressure લો;internal/external pressures consistently જુઓ.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Thin/thick મુખ્યત્વે wall/radius modelling distinction છે,ફક્ત low/high-pressureનું નામ નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ elementary stress-design calculations છે,code compliance,inspection approval કે vessel build/test કરવાની permission નહિ.

દરેક Open Tubeમાં Longitudinal Membrane Formula લાગુ?

ના.Closed-end pressure-load assumption લાગુ હોવું જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify shape, orientation, service and pressure condition separately.

Understand why

Cylindrical, spherical and other shapes may be vertical/horizontal; storage receivers, reactors, boiler drums and hydraulic cylinders serve different duties.

Example design-study pressure ranges:receiver.6–1.0MPa, selected process vessels.5–4MPa, selected hydraulic cylinders10–35MPa. These teaching ranges are not a universal industrial classification or substitute for actual ratings.

The same geometry can require different design at higher temperature or cyclic duty; external pressure can govern by buckling.

State actual design pressure/temperature, fluid, hazards, corrosion, cycles, joint details and applicable code before real design.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shape,orientation,service,pressure condition અલગ classify કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cylindrical,spherical shapes vertical/horizontal હોઈ શકે;receivers,reactors,boiler drums,hydraulic cylindersની duties જુદી.

Example design-study pressure ranges:receiver.6–1.0MPa,selected process vessels.5–4MPa,selected hydraulic cylinders10–35MPa.આ teaching ranges universal industrial classification કે actual ratingsના substitutes નથી.

Higher temperature,cyclic dutyમાં same geometryને જુદું design જોઈએ;external pressureમાં buckling governing બને.

Real design પહેલાં actual pressure/temperature,fluid,hazards,corrosion,cycles,joint details,code જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a closed thin cylinder, use a membrane model when wall thickness is small relative to diameter.

Understand why

Longitudinal cut:pressure opening force=pDL; two wall strips resist with2tL, so hoop stress=pD/(2t).

Transverse end cut:pressure force=p pi D²/4; wall area≈pi Dt, so longitudinal stress=pD/(4t).

Longitudinal stress formula assumes closed ends transmitting the end load through the wall; open-end arrangements differ.

A common elementary guide isD/t≥20; it is not a substitute for a code-specific applicability rule. Radial stress is neglected only in the thin model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Closed thin cylinderમાં thickness diameter સામે ઓછી હોય ત્યારે membrane model લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Longitudinal cutમાં pressure force pDL;બે stripsનું area2tL,એટલે hoop stress pD/(2t).

Transverse end cutમાં force p pi D²/4;wall area≈pi Dt,એટલે longitudinal stress pD/(4t).

Longitudinal formula closed endsનો end load wallમાં transfer થાય તે માને;open-end arrangement જુદી.

Common elementary guide D/t≥20;code-specific ruleનો substitute નહિ.Radial stress thin modelમાં જ neglect થાય.

body.en:
Given and model

p2MPa, D500mm, allowable80MPa, stated simplified joint efficiencyeta.9, corrosion allowance2mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Required effective t=pD/(2sigma eta)=2×500/(2×80×.9)=6.9444mm
  2. Nominal minimum=6.9444+2=8.9444mm; trial nominal10mm
  3. Effective service thickness=10−2=8mm
  4. Hoop check=2×500/(2×8×.9)=69.4444MPa
  5. Longitudinal check=2×500/(4×8×.9)=34.7222MPa
  6. Thin ratio D/teffective=500/8=62.5

Common mistake / conditions

This uses a supplied elementary efficiency model, not a claimed pressure-code formula. Mill tolerance, heads, nozzles, weld categories and code minimums are additional.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

p2MPa,D500mm,allowable80MPa,simplified joint efficiency eta.9,corrosion allowance2mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Required effective t=pD/(2sigma eta)=2×500/(2×80×.9)=6.9444mm
  2. Nominal minimum=6.9444+2=8.9444mm;trial nominal10mm
  3. Effective service thickness=10−2=8mm
  4. Hoop check=2×500/(2×8×.9)=69.4444MPa
  5. Longitudinal check=2×500/(4×8×.9)=34.7222MPa
  6. Thin ratio D/teffective=500/8=62.5

Common Mistake / શરતો

Supplied elementary efficiency model છે,pressure-code formulaનો દાવો નહિ.Mill tolerance,heads,nozzles,weld categories,code minimums વધારાના છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a long elastic isotropic cylinder, radial and hoop stresses vary with radius.

Understand why

With tension-positive sign:sigma r=A−B/r², sigma theta=A+B/r².

Boundary conditions:sigma r(ri)=−pi, sigma r(ro)=−po; A=(pi ri²−po ro²)/(ro²−ri²), B=(pi−po)ri²ro²/(ro²−ri²).

For closed ends carrying pressure load, uniform axial stresssigma z=A in the elementary model; open ends/support effects differ.

Thickness selection needs a failure criterion because the wall has a multiaxial stress state.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Long elastic isotropic cylinderમાં radial,hoop stresses radius સાથે બદલાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Tension-positive signમાં sigma r=A−B/r²,sigma theta=A+B/r².

Boundary sigma r(ri)=−pi,sigma r(ro)=−po;A=(pi ri²−po ro²)/(ro²−ri²),B=(pi−po)ri²ro²/(ro²−ri²).

Closed endsનો pressure load carry થાય તો elementary modelમાં uniform sigma z=A;open ends/support effects જુદાં.

Wallમાં multiaxial stress હોવાથી thickness માટે failure criterion જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

ri50mm, ro75mm, pi20MPa, po0; closed ends, elastic Lamé model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=20×50²/(75²−50²)=16MPa
  2. B=20×50²×75²/(75²−50²)=90000MPa mm²
  3. At ri:sigma r=16−90000/50²=−20MPa
  4. At ri:sigma theta=16+90000/50²=52MPa
  5. At ro:sigma r=0; sigma theta=32MPa; sigma z=16MPa

Common mistake / conditions

Inner hoop stress is maximum, but maximum principal difference there is52−(−20)=72MPa; a ductile yield check must consider the full state.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

ri50mm,ro75mm,pi20MPa,po0;closed ends,elastic Lamé model.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. A=20×50²/(75²−50²)=16MPa
  2. B=20×50²×75²/(75²−50²)=90000MPa mm²
  3. At ri:sigma r=16−90000/50²=−20MPa
  4. At ri:sigma theta=16+90000/50²=52MPa
  5. At ro:sigma r=0;sigma theta=32MPa;sigma z=16MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Inner hoop maximum છે,પણ maximum principal difference52−(−20)=72MPa;ductile yieldingમાં full state જુઓ.

body.en:
Given and model

ri50mm, pi20MPa, po0; compare two explicitly stated allowable criteria using S80MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Max-hoop-only criterion:ro≥ri sqrt[(S+p)/(S−p)]=50sqrt(100/60)=64.5497mm
  2. That trial thickness≈14.5497mm checks hoop only
  3. Tresca yield-difference criterion:sigma theta−sigma r≤S
  4. Then ro≥ri sqrt[S/(S−2p)]=50sqrt(80/40)=70.7107mm
  5. Select ro75mm:principal difference72MPa<80MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The smaller hoop-only result is not a substitute for the stated ductile Tresca check. Code design may impose a different allowable formulation and extra rules.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

ri50mm,pi20MPa,po0;S80MPaથી બે stated allowable criteria compare કરો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Max-hoop-only criterion:ro≥ri sqrt[(S+p)/(S−p)]=50sqrt(100/60)=64.5497mm
  2. That trial thickness≈14.5497mm checks hoop only
  3. Tresca yield-difference criterion:sigma theta−sigma r≤S
  4. Then ro≥ri sqrt[S/(S−2p)]=50sqrt(80/40)=70.7107mm
  5. Select ro75mm:principal difference72MPa<80MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Smaller hoop-only result stated ductile Tresca checkનો substitute નહિ.Codeમાં જુદું allowable formulation,extra rules હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A hemisphere pressure force is balanced by membrane tension around its cut rim.

Understand why

Pressure force=p pi D²/4; resisting area≈pi Dt; thus sigma=pD/(4t).

The two orthogonal surface membrane stresses are equal; for the sameD, t, p, this equals half the thin-cylinder hoop stress.

Weld efficiency, corrosion, openings, supports and pressure-code provisions still affect a real sphere.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Hemisphereની pressure force cut rimની membrane tensionથી balance થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pressure force p pi D²/4;resisting area≈pi Dt;તેથી sigma=pD/(4t).

બે orthogonal surface stresses equal;same D,t,pમાં cylinder hoop stressથી અડધું.

Real sphereમાં weld efficiency,corrosion,openings,supports,code provisions અસર કરે.

body.en:
Given and model

p2MPa, D800mm, allowable100MPa; seamless idealised membrane model, no corrosion allowance in this example.

Step-by-step solution

  1. tmin=pD/(4sigma)=2×800/(4×100)=4mm
  2. Select t5mm:membrane stress=2×800/(4×5)=80MPa
  3. D/t=800/5=160

Common mistake / conditions

This trial passes only the stated membrane criterion, not a complete manufactured-vessel design.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

p2MPa,D800mm,allowable100MPa;seamless idealised model,આ exampleમાં corrosion allowance નથી.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. tmin=pD/(4sigma)=2×800/(4×100)=4mm
  2. Select t5mm:membrane stress=2×800/(4×5)=80MPa
  3. D/t=800/5=160

Common Mistake / શરતો

Trial ફક્ત stated membrane criterionમાં pass;complete manufactured-vessel design નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Separate educational membrane sizing from legal/safety design approval.

Understand why

Check pressure difference, temperature, material properties, allowable criterion, thin/thick applicability and units.

Include effective thickness after allowances/tolerance; check heads, openings, closures, supports and local stresses.

External pressure, cyclic load, brittle fracture, corrosion and inspection can govern beyond simple hoop stress.

Never improvise a pressure test or build from an illustrative calculation; competent code design and authorised procedures are essential.

Does passing sigma hoop alone prove a thick ductile cylinder safe?

No. The radial/axial stresses and chosen yield criterion matter.

Does added corrosion allowance carry the service load forever?

No. Check effective remaining thickness after the specified loss.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Educational membrane sizing,legal/safety approvalને જુદાં રાખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pressure difference,temperature,material properties,criterion,thin/thick applicability,units જુઓ.

Allowances/tolerance પછી effective thickness લો;heads,openings,closures,supports,local stresses જુઓ.

External pressure,cycles,brittle fracture,corrosion,inspection simple hoopથી વધારે governing બને.

Illustrative calculation પરથી vessel build કે improvised pressure test નહિ;competent code design,authorised procedures જરૂરી.

ફક્ત Hoop Stress Passથી Thick Ductile Cylinder Safe?

ના.Radial/axial stress,chosen yield criterion મહત્વનાં.

Corrosion Allowance હંમેશાં Load લેતું રહે?

ના.Specified loss પછી effective remaining thicknessથી check કરો.
